title: IRON SHIPS & YUNKISH ASH // BATTLE OF MEEREEN
narrative: The Iron Victory's ram smashed cleanly through the oar-banks of a triple-decked Yunkish war galley with a sound like thunder. Victarion leaped from the prow into the enemy forecastle, his kraken-crested greathelm roaring. In his right hand, his charred, smoking arm gripped an iron battleaxe that whistled through mail, bone, and flesh. Behind him, nine hundred reavers poured over the bulwarks with hooked axes, hurling firepots into the slave-soldier ranks. The Meereen harbor turned crimson with blood, salt foam, and burning pitch as the ironborn shattered the blockade in thirty brutal minutes.
